summary.title: Aplikasi Toko Online - Threat Model
summary.description: Threat model lengkap untuk aplikasi manajemen toko online (threaddragon.com) dengan React Frontend, Node.js REST API Server, MySQL Database, Redis Cache, Email Service, dan Payment Gateway Integration (Midtrans/Xendit). Mencakup 9 ancaman STRIDE dengan 52 mitigasi dan 5 security requirements.

cells.name: Redis Cache

cells.name: User Input & Browse
cells.description: Customer melakukan input (login, register, search, order)

cells.name: Admin Management
cells.description: Admin mengelola produk, order, dan transaksi melalui frontend

cells.name: REST API Calls

cells.name: Database Queries

cells.name: Cache Operations

cells.name: Webhook Callback

cells.name: Email Notification

cells.name: Authentication
cells.description: API menggunakan auth module untuk token generation dan validation

cells.title: THREAT-001: Spoofing Identitas User - Session Hijacking
cells.description: Attacker dapat mencuri JWT token melalui XSS atau network sniffing untuk mengakses akun user. Session hijacking, token theft via XSS, long-lived tokens tanpa refresh strategy.

mitigations.title: Token Expiration - JWT: 30 menit access token, 7 hari refresh token
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict Cookie Storage
Token Rotation Strategy - new refresh token setiap kali digunakan
CSRF Protection - SameSite=Strict, CSRF token untuk POST/PUT/DELETE
XSS Prevention - input validation, output encoding, CSP headers
Monitoring - alert login dari IP/device baru atau unusual patterns

cells.title: THREAT-002: Tampering Data Harga Produk
cells.description: Attacker dapat mengubah harga produk di frontend sebelum melakukan pembayaran. Browser console manipulation, network request modification, direct API call dengan harga salah.

mitigations.title: Server-side Price Validation (WAJIB) - fetch price dari database, bandingkan
Recalculate Total Price di Backend - jangan trust frontend calculation
Digital Signature pada Order Data - HMAC-SHA256(order_data + secret_key)
Database Constraints - PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE, NOT NULL, CHECK constraints
Audit Logging - log setiap perubahan harga dengan timestamp, user, old/new value

cells.title: THREAT-003: Information Disclosure - Kebocoran Data Customer
cells.description: Attacker dapat mengakses data customer yang sensitive melalui API endpoint yang tidak ter-protect. Unauthenticated API access, broken access control, database error exposure, API return sensitive data.

mitigations.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest - AES-256 untuk email, phone, address, SSN
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) - authorization check di setiap endpoint
Data Masking di API Responses - email: user****@mail.com, phone: 0812****6789
Parameterized Queries - prevent SQL injection, use prepared statements
Encrypt Database Backups - GPG encryption atau AWS KMS
Error Handling - jangan expose database details di error messages
HTTPS Only Communication - TLS 1.2+, HSTS headers, disable weak ciphers

cells.title: THREAT-004: Denial of Service (DoS) - Server Overload
cells.description: Attacker dapat overload server dengan request volume tinggi, menyebabkan service unavailable. HTTP request flooding, database connection exhaustion, memory exhaustion.

mitigations.title: Rate Limiting - 10 requests per minute per IP, exponential backoff
CAPTCHA untuk Forms Sensitive - Google reCAPTCHA v3 atau hCaptcha
DDoS Protection - CDN dengan built-in DDoS (CloudFlare, AWS CloudFront)
Database Connection Pooling - limit 20-50 connections, timeout 30 seconds
Request Queuing & Throttling - Bull queue, Redis-based queue
Email Rate Limiting - max 5 emails per minute per user
Web Application Firewall (WAF) - AWS WAF, ModSecurity, atau CloudFlare WAF

cells.title: THREAT-005: Elevation of Privilege - Unauthorized Admin Access
cells.description: Regular user dapat mengakses admin functions atau escalate privilege mereka. Missing authorization checks, broken access control, role bypass.

mitigations.title: JWT Role-Based Authorization - include role dalam JWT, verify di setiap endpoint
Authorization Middleware - verify user role sebelum handler execute
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) untuk Admin - TOTP atau U2F key
IP Whitelisting untuk Admin Panel - restrict ke office/VPN IP
Audit Logging untuk Admin Actions - log CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE
Admin Session Timeout - 15 menit inactivity, require re-authentication
Principle of Least Privilege - Super Admin, Product Manager, Order Manager roles

cells.title: THREAT-006: Tampering Transaksi Pembayaran
cells.description: Attacker dapat memanipulasi status transaksi pembayaran tanpa benar-benar melakukan pembayaran. Webhook replay, forged response, no signature verification.

mitigations.title: Webhook Signature Verification (WAJIB) - HMAC-SHA256, verify setiap webhook
Server-side Payment Status Verification - query payment provider untuk confirm
Idempotency Key - unique key per payment, reject duplicate requests
Transaction Timeout - auto-cancel pending setelah 15 menit
Merchant Key Rotation - change key setiap 6 bulan, support dual key
Payment Transaction Logging - log amount, status, timestamp, webhook result
Fraud Detection System - alert jika amount > threshold atau unusual pattern

cells.title: THREAT-007: SQL Injection Attack
cells.description: Attacker dapat inject SQL commands melalui unsanitized input untuk mengakses atau memodifikasi database. String concatenation queries, union-based injection.

mitigations.title: Parameterized Queries (WAJIB) - gunakan ? placeholder atau named parameters
Input Validation & Sanitization - whitelist allowed characters
Use ORM Framework - Sequelize, TypeORM, atau Prisma dengan query builder
Database Least Privilege - app user hanya SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE (no DROP/ALTER)
Error Handling - hide database details, log server-side, return generic error
WAF Rules untuk SQL Injection - ModSecurity, AWS WAF SQL patterns
Regular Penetration Testing - monthly SAST, quarterly manual testing

cells.title: THREAT-008: Repudiation - User Deny Transaksi
cells.description: User dapat menyangkal bahwa mereka melakukan transaksi tertentu karena tidak ada proof. No audit trail, no transaction signing, missing confirmation.

mitigations.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging - user_id, action, IP, user_agent, timestamp
Transaction Signing - HMAC-SHA256(transaction_data + user_secret)
Immutable Transaction Records - append-only logs, no UPDATE/DELETE
Email Confirmation - send confirmation untuk setiap transaksi penting
2FA untuk Sensitive Actions - require OTP jika amount > threshold
Device Fingerprinting - log user_agent, IP, device fingerprint, geolocation

cells.title: THREAT-009: Command Injection - Email Header Injection
cells.description: Attacker dapat inject commands di email headers untuk spam atau send ke unauthorized recipients. CRLF injection, raw user input dalam email headers.

mitigations.title: Email Header Sanitization - remove newlines, carriage returns, semicolons
Input Validation - name: max 100 chars, alphanumeric + spaces only
Use Safe Template Engine - Handlebars, EJS dengan automatic escaping
SPF, DKIM, DMARC Configuration - prevent email spoofing
